subject: general
question: Which of the following is an exclusive martial dance form of Manipur?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thang Ta**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Thang Ta is an exclusive martial dance from Manipur that includes the unique display of skill, creativity, and agility in which dance performers enact a mock fight sequence. 
 
• Thang Ta is an ancient Manipuri Martial Art developed from the war environment of Manipur & created by the Meitei.
 
• It is also known as the art of sword and spear, this Manipuri traditional dance features a wide range of martial arts weaponry in its performance.
